contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left, mantled with spear over left shoulder. Legend appears to have been removed. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left on prow with diagonal spear, propped shield right. Diameter: 17.1mm, Weight: 2.07gms, die axis: 6
